d:
A small woodpecker species with a cream-colored head and a deep crimson crest. It has small, round black eyes and a sharp, pale yellow beak. The body is primarily deep crimson with a cream-colored belly and small, pointed wings; it has two claws per foot and no wings for flight in a humanoid sense, but possesses avian wings. The tail is short, stubby, and deep crimson.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
